Can Pakistani Students Get Scholarships in Canada?

Yes. Most Canadian scholarships for Pakistani students are international awards, not Pakistan-only schemes. A scholarship in Canada for Pakistani students may be automatic with admission, require a separate application, or depend on a school or faculty nomination.

The important question is not whether “Pakistan” appears in the scholarship name. It is whether international students at your study level can apply.

Fully Funded Scholarships in Canada for Pakistani Students

The phrase “fully funded” is used loosely online. Here it means tuition plus substantial residence or living support, not simply a tuition discount.

Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship

The Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship is one of the strongest undergraduate options. It covers tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years. About 37 scholars are selected each year.

A practical example: an A Level student in Lahore cannot wait until November to start. The school nomination closes first, so the process needs to begin well before October.

UBC International Scholars Program

The UBC International Scholars Program combines academic achievement, leadership and significant financial need. It is for international students entering their first undergraduate degree directly from secondary school.

For 2027 entry, the award application is due on 15 November 2026 and the UBC application for International Scholars consideration is due on 1 December 2026. The general Winter Session application closes on 15 January 2027.

UBC does not publish one fixed value for this need-based route because support depends on assessed financial need. That is more useful than attaching an invented “full scholarship” figure to every applicant.

McCall MacBain Scholarship

For eligible master’s and professional programmes at McGill, the McCall MacBain Scholarship covers tuition and fees and provides a CAD 2,300 monthly living stipend during academic terms, plus a relocation grant.

For the 2027 cohort, international applicants studying or graduating outside Canada and the United States must apply by 19 August 2026 at 4:00 pm ET.

If you are searching for Canada fully funded scholarships for Pakistani students, these routes deserve attention before generic scholarship lists.

Undergraduate Scholarships for Pakistani Students

UBC International Major Entrance Scholarship

UBC automatically considers eligible international applicants for IMES when they apply by the admission deadline.

For 2026/27, the published value is CAD 10,000 to 25,000 a year, renewable for up to three additional years. UBC has not yet published a separate 2027/28 value, so treat this as the latest published amount, not a guaranteed 2027 figure.

UBC also makes an important distinction: IMES can be substantial, but it does not cover the full cost of education.

York President’s International Scholarship of Excellence

York’s President’s International Scholarship of Excellence is worth CAD 45,000 a year, or CAD 180,000 over four years.

It targets international high-school applicants with excellent academics, leadership and community involvement. York has also published a previous recipient from Pakistan, confirming that Pakistani students can compete for the award.

University of Calgary International Entrance Scholarship

The University of Calgary International Entrance Scholarship is worth CAD 20,000 and can be renewed for years two, three and four if the conditions are met. That can reach CAD 80,000 over four years.

Here is the counterintuitive part: a smaller scholarship at a lower-cost university can leave you with a lower final bill than a larger award at a more expensive institution.

Compare lower-cost Canadian university options before deciding.

Master’s Scholarships in Canada for Pakistani Students

Waterloo International Master’s Award of Excellence

The Waterloo IMAE is aimed at eligible international students normally entering a research-based master’s programme.

It pays CAD 2,500 per term for up to five terms, giving a maximum published value of CAD 12,500. Faculties nominate candidates from their admission applications.

Is CGRS-M Open to Pakistani Students?

Not for a typical international applicant applying directly from Pakistan.

The federal CGRS-M rules require applicants to be Canadian citizens, permanent residents or Protected Persons by the application deadline.

PhD Scholarships for Pakistani Students in Canada

Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Doctoral

The current federal doctoral award is CGRS-D.

It pays CAD 40,000 a year for 36 months, giving a total value of CAD 120,000. The direct agency deadline is 17 October, although university deadlines can be considerably earlier.

International applicants must already be registered in a doctoral programme at an eligible Canadian institution by the application deadline. Up to 15% of awards are available to international applicants.

For Pakistani students, CGRS-D is therefore not normally a pre-admission scholarship from Pakistan. Secure and begin the eligible Canadian PhD first, then use the correct institutional or agency route.

Is Vanier Still Open?

No.

The official Vanier programme no longer accepts applications and directs prospective doctoral applicants to CGRS-D.

That matters because several pages still present Vanier as a live Canadian scholarship.

How Much Does a Scholarship Actually Save?

A scholarship amount only tells you half the story.

IRCC currently requires a single study-permit applicant outside Quebec to show CAD 22,895 for one year of living expenses, excluding tuition and transport. The official proof-of-funds guidance states that the figure is updated annually.

Suppose annual tuition is CAD 35,000 and you receive a CAD 20,000 scholarship. You still need CAD 15,000 for tuition, plus living costs and travel.

That simple calculation is more useful than calling an award “large” or “small”.

Students building a realistic budget should also check health insurance costs for international students.

How to Apply for a Scholarship in Canada from Pakistan

Start with the degree, then the scholarship.

  1. Shortlist Canadian programmes you would genuinely attend.
  2. Mark each award as automatic, separate application or nomination-based.
  3. Confirm international eligibility at your study level.
  4. Work backwards from the earliest deadline.
  5. Prepare transcripts, passport, references, essays and English-language evidence where required.
  6. Verify the final amount and deadline on the official source.

The point applicants often miss is the order. Pearson starts with a school nomination. A polished essay cannot rescue a missed nomination deadline.

If English testing is part of your planning, check accepted alternatives to IELTS at Canadian universities rather than assuming every scholarship follows one IELTS rule.

MBBS Scholarships for Pakistani Students in Canada

Searches for MBBS scholarships for Pakistani students in Canada are common, but Canada generally uses the MD degree, while McGill uses MDCM, rather than the MBBS structure familiar in Pakistan.

A Canada MBBS scholarship for Pakistani students is therefore not usually a separate national scholarship category. Medical-school entry for international students can also be highly restricted and may require previous university study.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are the best scholarships for Pakistani students in Canada?

For undergraduate study, Pearson, UBC International Scholars, UBC IMES, York PISE and Calgary are strong options. McCall MacBain is a leading master’s scholarship, while CGRS-D is a major doctoral award for eligible students already registered in Canada.

Are there fully funded scholarships for Pakistani students in Canada?

Yes. Pearson covers tuition, books, incidental fees and residence for four years. McCall MacBain covers eligible tuition and fees and provides a CAD 2,300 monthly stipend during academic terms. UBC also offers need-and-merit International Scholars awards.

Which Canadian scholarships for Pakistani students are available for undergraduate study?

Pearson, UBC International Scholars, UBC IMES, York PISE and Calgary’s International Entrance Scholarship are key undergraduate routes.

Can I get a Canada scholarship for Pakistani students undergraduate applicants without IELTS?

There is no single rule that removes IELTS. Some universities accept other English evidence, but admission and scholarship requirements must be checked separately.

Can Pakistani students apply for CGRS-D?

Yes, conditionally. International applicants must already be registered in an eligible Canadian doctoral programme when they apply.

Are there MBBS scholarships in Canada for Pakistani students?

Which Scholarship Should You Target?

The best scholarship for Pakistani students in Canada is not automatically the one with the biggest headline value. It is the award you are eligible for, can apply to on time, and can combine with a realistic plan for the remaining cost.
